limitations: No complete independent certification of the 18 modules or their headers: unexercised functions are explicit in each report/inventory.
No macOS runtime, Windows ASan/MSan, full research dataset or end-to-end >4-GiB scientific analysis.
No exhaustive storage/allocator/permission failure, process termination or graph rendering matrix.
Coverage records the first instrumented production run plus the module run; aborting paths need sanitizer evidence and may not flush gcov.
Pristine upstream gzip PED/BED and failures intentionally differ from previously corrected port behavior.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `truncated-tgeno`: `mcio.c:3091` calls perror after a nonnegative short read. Linux prints `Success`, Windows `No error`. Both reject the file.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited EOF misuse with a Windows terminal mismatch. The earlier packed-reader F024 repair remains valid; extend its length-vs-negative-read handling to this transposed reader.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `cli-invalid-option`, `cli-missing-value`: MinGW wording/quotation differs from glibc.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Windows regression. qpDstat has not selected the existing `admix_getopt` adapter used by corrected qpWave; reuse it behind a platform guard and compare both streams.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `popsizelimit` equals default; seeds 77/123 agree with each other but disagree with their independently sampled 15-person physical subsets. Source builds analysis indices before setplimit and never parses/initializes its seed.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited silent selection defect. Apply the existing sampler before constructing indices, parse/initialize the existing RNG, and compare corrected Linux and Windows subset oracles. qpWave's F045 repair stays closed.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: Zero/negative/NaN/infinite block sizes are accepted; INT_MAX chromosome count triggers signed-overflow UBSan at `numchrom+1`.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited local validation gap. Validate complete finite settings and representable chromosome counts before arithmetic; retain valid defaults. This does not reopen the corrected qpWave code.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `duplicate-ind` exits zero; direct `M11-duplicate` proves the existing validator rejects the same IDs.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited missing caller validation. Validate IDs before genotype loading in qpDstat and recheck every input format and id2pops mapping.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `output`/`outputname` replace an existing sentinel with an empty file; results remain on stdout. `-v` prints a version plus a no-parameters message/tool header. colcalc/fullmode/nostatslim/msjack controls and forceclade have no operative analysis path here.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited misleading interface. Reject unsupported controls or separately specify their implementation; do not invent legacy statistical behavior. Preserve ordinary stdout and document redirection.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `tree-five`: gettreelen allocates six-element arrays but uses global pair index `h` to address them (`qpDstat.c:1349â€“1350`). ASan reports heap overflow. Pristine Linux crashes; Windows can print additional corrupted results and exit zero.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited memory/scientific defect. Index six local pairs by `i`, retain the global index only for reading f2, and verify four/five-population permutations and missingness on corrected Linux.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `banker-type3` writes past cc[3]; `banker-many` writes 101 entries into zz[100] in islegal. ASan identifies both stack overflows; ordinary builds can accept them.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited bounds defects. Validate banker types and size the population-presence vector from checked dimensions; retain legal quartet ordering.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `poplist-capacity` and `quad-capacity` name more populations than the 54-person-sized buffers. ASan reports writes beyond eglist/ztypes. `M18-capacity` reproduces typed-list caller overflow independently.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited capacity contract. Count/check names before writes and use bounded typed/untyped loaders; keep the upstream file syntax and ordering. M18 and all list callers require checks.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `fourier`, `fourier-five` and direct M17 Fourier probes: lag correlation length `g-k+2` reads past g+1 arrays. g=0 also writes beyond zero-length work arrays. ASan reports the actual shared qpsubs.c path; ordinary results/termination are unreliable.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited shared numerical/memory defect. Establish the intended lag/window contract, bound all arrays and require valid dimensions before computing; retain every correlation/result line in corrected-reference comparisons. Do not infer a scientific repair from a tolerance.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `oracle-zero`: estimate 0, independent SD **0.218218**, printed SD **1.000000** on all ordinary builds. qpDstat initializes serr to 1 when Z=0 instead of retaining the computed SD.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited printed scientific error. Return the actual jackknife SD from getdsc and preserve the established output precision/order. Check both explicit and generated quartets, including zero variance.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M12-small-normal`: valid five-sample normal allocation aborts because padding is tested against 4 rather than the minimum 48-byte row. SIZE_MAX allocation is unchecked; `M12-header-size` writes 66 bytes into the 48-byte header buffer.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited dimension/header/allocation defects in geno.c. Use checked integer byte calculations, validate addressable/serializable dimensions, check allocation, and make header writing bounded. No format redesign.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M12-read-invalid`: a 48-byte `TGENO invalid` header can be accepted in the sanitizer run or produce uninitialized dimension-dependent sizes elsewhere. sscanf's result is unchecked; short-header and fstat validity are not established before use.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited malformed-header integrity defect. Require a complete bounded header, parsed field count, valid dimensions/products and file length before constructing a live matrix; verify no scientific content is silently synthesized.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M12-map-leak`: 16 empty-file read attempts leave **16 descriptors/handles** on Windows and Linux. genotype_matrix_read_file returns -2 before closing fd.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited resource defect, separate from corrected M13 constructMap. Close fd on every read/map outcome and specify/restore the failed object's state.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M12-write-missing` passes a missing-parent output path; unchecked fopen returns NULL and fwrite faults. The actual transpose executable rejects its own missing-output case through its exit path, recorded separately.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited M12 API failure handling. Check output open/write/close before dereference, preserve errno/diagnostic routing, and recheck writer consumers. Do not generalize the direct API crash to every caller.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M07-hash`: UBSan reaches signed shifts in xlhash; xhash2 also has unchecked signed multiplication for extreme keys. Ordinary tested hashes agree across OSes.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited undefined arithmetic outside already repaired hash paths. Specify existing modulo-bit behavior with unsigned operations and retain ordinary/extreme hash oracles; no new hash algorithm.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M20-singular` and `tree-haploid`: regressit prints rr as an n-by-n matrix although rr has n entries (`regsubs.c:58`). ASan reports the read through printmatwl.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited error-path memory defect. Print the correct vector shape, release all failure-path allocations, and test singular/nonfinite callers without changing successful fitting order.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M18-file-leak`: 16 loadlist_type calls leave **16 descriptors/handles** on both platforms; egsubs.c omits fclose.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited lifetime defect. Close the file on normal completion and cover malformed/early exits and repeated callers.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `crlf-macro` / `M03-parser-crlf`: macro DIR/ROOT contains a residual carriage return; substitution splits the resulting pathname. Both Linux and Windows reproduce it on identical CRLF bytes.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited CRLF input defect especially relevant to Windows authoring. Strip the complete line ending before substitution while preserving internal whitespace/quoting; test LF/CRLF and includes. Verified workaround: UTF-8 parameter files with LF.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `M06-median-leak`: LeakSanitizer records 8- and 16-byte allocations leaked by median's one/two-value early returns.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited library leak. Free the temporary array on both early returns; verify median values and repeated use.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `caller-qpDpart`: first patternscore frees borrowed `cp`, the last colprobs row (`qpDpart.c:702`); the second quartet reads it at line 657. ASan reports heap-use-after-free; Windows faults.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited sibling-tool ownership defect. Keep row ownership in the parent and free only owned work buffers. Record under T22; this targeted discovery is not a complete qpDpart audit.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: Focused gzip ownership run: current Linux leaves decompressed text/packed/transposed and reader-fatal temp files under /var/tmp; pristine also leaves early-return temporaries. Windows cleans its owned inputs.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited Unix lifecycle issue. Share owned cleanup across reader returns/errors while preserving Windows behavior. The runner hashes/removes only files absent before that invocation and leaves pre-existing files alone.

findings.reproducer_and_observation: `tree-haploid`: one male per population on X, xmode/inbreed enabled. setf2 computes 0/0 at t=1; ordinary builds print NaN tree diagnostics and can exit zero. ASan subsequently reaches F066.
findings.classification_and_proposed_repair: Inherited haploid tree correction gap. Establish the upstream-supported haploid tree contract, use the applicable finite correction or explicitly reject unsupported tree inputs before output; do not guess a new estimator.
